=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- File: .github/workflows/ci.yml
  Line or code reference: Lines ~644-650, the `rg -n 'read_codex_stall_guard_state\(\)|codex_stall_guard_kill_detected\(\)'` block
  Problem: The anti-regression inline-pattern detection grep scans `.github/workflows/implement.yml` and `scripts/validate_process.sh` but omits `scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh`. review_apply_fixes.sh had its own inline definitions of `read_codex_stall_guard_state()` and `resolve_editor_network_probe_pid()` removed in this PR. If those inline function definitions are reintroduced in review_apply_fixes.sh during a future merge, rebase, or manual edit, CI will not catch the regression because that file is not scanned.
  Why it fails at runtime: A reintroduced inline `read_codex_stall_guard_state()` in review_apply_fixes.sh would shadow the sourced watchdog_helpers.sh version, and the CI guard designed to prevent exactly this regression would pass silently.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- File: .github/workflows/ci.yml
  Line or code reference: Lines ~644-650, the grep pattern `read_codex_stall_guard_state\(\)|codex_stall_guard_kill_detected\(\)`
  Problem: The anti-regression inline-pattern grep omits `resolve_editor_network_probe_pid\(\)` from its detection pattern. This function was extracted from `scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh` into `scripts/watchdog_helpers.sh` in this PR. If a future change reintroduces an inline `resolve_editor_network_probe_pid()` definition anywhere, the CI guard will not catch it.
  Why it fails at runtime: Same class of regression as above — an extracted function could be silently reintroduced inline, defeating the purpose of the extraction.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- File: scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh
  Line or code reference: Line 1452, the still-present inline `_reap_editor_fifo_holders()` definition
  Problem: The `_reap_editor_fifo_holders` function was added to `scripts/watchdog_helpers.sh` as a shared helper, but the identical inline definition at line 1452 of `scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh` was NOT removed. This means review_apply_fixes.sh now sources watchdog_helpers.sh (which defines `_reap_editor_fifo_holders`) and then later redefines it inline at line 1452. The sourced version is silently shadowed and never exercised in the review_apply_fixes.sh code path. If a future bug fix is applied only to watchdog_helpers.sh, review_apply_fixes.sh will not benefit.
  Why it fails at runtime: The extraction is incomplete. The inline definition shadows the shared helper, so any divergence between the two copies (e.g., a bug fix applied to only one) would lead to inconsistent behavior in the review_autofix editor path.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- File: scripts/memory_helpers.sh
  Line or code reference: Lines 85-88, `memory_bootstrap` unknown-argument handler
  Problem: Unknown arguments to `memory_bootstrap` are treated as non-fatal (`return 0`) with only a warning to stderr. A typo like `--ensure-brnahc` would silently skip the branch-creation step without any error exit or visible CI failure.
  Why it fails at runtime: A call site that mistakenly passes a misspelled `--ensure-branch` would proceed without creating the ai-memory branch, but downstream memory operations would fail later with less-clear errors. The fail-open design is consistent with the codebase philosophy, but the absence of any error exit on unrecognized flags means configuration mistakes are silently absorbed.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 2
- File: scripts/codex_helpers.sh
  Line or code reference: Line 102, `bash "${writer_path}" "${writer_args[@]}"`
  Problem: `codex_config_assemble` does not verify that `writer_path` (the resolved path to `write_codex_config.sh`) exists and is executable before invoking it. If the resolution produces a path to a missing file, the `bash` invocation will fail, but the error message from bash (`bash: /path/to/missing: No such file or directory`) is less diagnostic than an explicit guard would produce.
  Why it fails at runtime: Under `set -euo pipefail`, a missing writer script would still cause the step to fail — the defect is limited to a less-helpful error message rather than silent misbehavior. The blast radius is low.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 2
- Requirement: "Land helper definitions plus lint checks first inside the PR. Then replace call sites one workflow at a time in separate commits within the same PR."
  Expected change site: Multiple commits within the PR.
  Evidence of absence: The PR consists of a single commit (92c05d9cbef53e1ee1fe00983ea76d47f1efe3cf) that bundles all 18 file changes together — helper definitions, call-site replacements, CI anti-regression checks, and test additions are all in one monolithic commit rather than layered across separate commits.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
